KaelthasFlamestrikeConvection.name: Convection
KaelthasFlamestrikeConvection.description: Quest: Damaging an enemy Hero with Flamestrike increase its damage by 5, up to 100. This bonus is lost on death. Reward: After hitting 20 enemy Heroes, increase Flamestrike damage by an additional 100 and no longer lose any bonuses on death.

KaelthasVerdantSpheresFelInfusion.name: Fel Infusion
KaelthasVerdantSpheresFelInfusion.description: Increases Kael'thas's Spell Power by 4%. Kael'thas heals for 94 (+4% per level) Health when activating Verdant Spheres.

KaelthasManaAddict.name: Mana Addict
KaelthasManaAddict.description: Quest: Gathering a Regeneration Globe increases Kael'thas's maximum Mana by 15. Reward: After gathering 20 Globes, Kael'thas can activate Arcane Barrier to gain a Shield equal to 100% of his maximum Mana for 4 seconds. 45 second cooldown.

KaelthasGravityLapseNetherWind.name: Nether Wind
KaelthasGravityLapseNetherWind.description: Increases Gravity Lapse's range by 30%. When Gravity Lapse hits an enemy Hero, refund 80 Mana.

KaelthasGravityLapseEnergyRoil.name: Energy Roil
KaelthasGravityLapseEnergyRoil.description: Reduce the Mana cost of Gravity Lapse by 70. If Gravity Lapse hits a Hero, reduce its cooldown by 8 seconds.

KaelthasFlamestrikeManaTap.name: Mana Tap
KaelthasFlamestrikeManaTap.description: Activating Verdant Spheres restores 5% of Kael'thas's maximum Mana.

KaelthasFlamestrikeBurnedFlesh.name: Burned Flesh
KaelthasFlamestrikeBurnedFlesh.description: When Flamestrike damages 2 or more Heroes, they take additional damage equal to 8% of their maximum Health.

KaelthasLivingBombSunKingsFury.name: Sun King's Fury
KaelthasLivingBombSunKingsFury.description: Living Bombs that spread to enemy Heroes deal 35% more damage.

KaelthasMasterySunfireEnchantment.name: Sunfire Enchantment
KaelthasMasterySunfireEnchantment.description: Activating Verdant Spheres causes Kael'thas's next 2 Basic Attacks to instead deal 115 (+4% per level) Spell Damage. If both of these Attacks hit enemy Heroes, gain 15% Spell Power for 10 seconds.

KaelthasHeroicAbilityPhoenix.name: Phoenix
KaelthasHeroicAbilityPhoenix.description: Launch a Phoenix to an area, dealing 84 (+4% per level) damage to enemies along the way. The Phoenix persists for 7 seconds, attacking enemies for 84 (+4% per level) damage and splashing for 42 (+4% per level) damage.

KaelthasHeroicAbilityPyroblast.name: Pyroblast
KaelthasHeroicAbilityPyroblast.description: After 1.5 seconds, cast a slow-moving fireball that deals 810 (+5% per level) damage to an enemy Hero and 405 (+5% per level) damage to enemies nearby.

KaelthasLivingBombPyromaniac.name: Pyromaniac
KaelthasLivingBombPyromaniac.description: Each time Living Bomb deals periodic damage, Kael'thas's Basic Ability cooldowns are reduced by 0.5 seconds.

KaelthasLivingBombBackdraft.name: Backdraft
KaelthasLivingBombBackdraft.description: Living Bomb's explosion slows enemy Movement Speed by 30% for 2 seconds.

KaelthasLivingBombFissionBomb.name: Fission Bomb
KaelthasLivingBombFissionBomb.description: Increases Living Bomb's explosion radius by 20%.

KaelthasFlamestrikeFuryOfTheSunwell.name: Fury of the Sunwell
KaelthasFlamestrikeFuryOfTheSunwell.description: Flamestrike will explode a second time 1.5 seconds later.

KaelthasLivingBombIgnite.name: Ignite
KaelthasLivingBombIgnite.description: Flamestrikes apply Living Bomb to the enemy Hero closest to its center who is not currently affected by Living Bomb.

KaelthasTwinSpheres.name: Twin Spheres
KaelthasTwinSpheres.description: Verdant Spheres gains a second charge. Passive: Kael'thas benefits from all of his level 7 talents.

KaelthasPhoenixRebirth.name: Rebirth
KaelthasPhoenixRebirth.description: Increases Phoenix duration by 100%. While alive, the Phoenix may be ordered to move to a different location.

KaelthasPyroblastPresenceOfMind.name: Presence Of Mind
KaelthasPyroblastPresenceOfMind.description: Increases Pyroblast's explosion radius by 50%. Heroes that are hit by Flamestrike or have Living Bomb spread to them reduce the cooldown of Pyroblast by 10 seconds.

KaelthasMasterOfFlames.name: Master of Flames
KaelthasMasterOfFlames.description: Living Bomb's spread from explosions can now also spread Living Bomb.

KaelthasMasteryFlamethrower.name: Flamethrower
KaelthasMasteryFlamethrower.description: Increases the cast range of Flamestrike by 40%. If Flamestrike hits 2 or more Heroes, its cooldown is reduced by 4 seconds.
